canada.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford commented on an alleged assault in Hamilton, saying the parents of two boys police say were involved should "give your kids a little ass whooping in the wood shed."

canada.title: Thompson will be home to Manitoba's latest Huddle youth support site
canada.summary: A new youth service group — the first of its kind in northern Manitoba — will open in Thompson early next year. The city will soon be home to a Huddle, a group that provides health, education, social supports and other programs.

canada.title: Operations at Quesnel River Pulp curtailed indefinitely, company says
canada.summary: Millar Western Forest Products Ltd. says it will indefinitely curtail operations at Quesnel River Pulp mill.

canada.title: What Winnipeg can learn from Toronto’s housing model
canada.summary: A new mental health and addictions hospital and housing units will be built in Winnipeg replicating a housing project based in Toronto.

canada.title: N.L. Housing Corporation to run new transitional housing program
canada.summary: The Newfoundland and Labrador government has cancelled its third request for proposals to replace the Horizons at 106 transitional housing program and will now run its own program.

canada.title: Roshel to buy Stellantis assembly plant in Brampton for undisclosed amount, automaker says
canada.summary: Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel Inc. will buy the Stellantis assembly plant in Brampton, Ont., the automaker announced Monday.

canada.title: After deaths of 2 brothers, Quebec coroner calls for improvements to REM station fence
canada.summary: A Quebec coroner says the REM light-rail network might have to re-evaluate the penetration-resistant fence around Du Quartier station in Brossard, after two young men were fatally hit by a train there about a year ago.

canada.title: Alberta plans to spend $39M to more than double the number of urgent care centres in province
canada.summary: The Alberta government is putting $39 million over three years toward planning nine new urgent care centres, which it says will ease pressure on crowded emergency rooms and reduce travel times for many patients.

canada.title: More charges for teen accused in fatal hit and run of Montreal cyclist
canada.summary: Two new charges have been filed against a teenage driver accused in the fatal hit and run of a cyclist in Montreal's Ahuntsic-Cartierville borough last month. The 17-year-old will remain in custody until the next scheduled court appearance.

canada.title: ‘Where is the accountability?’: Nunavut’s child advocate says territory’s protection issues aren’t being addressed
canada.summary: Jane Bates, Nunavut's child advocate says the territory's system of protecting vulnerable children isn't being properly addressed.

canada.title: Sask. introduces 'provincial safeguards' on MAID, mostly replicating new federal amendments
canada.summary: Health Minister Jeremy Cockrill says the provincial amendments would also strengthen "conscientious objection" protections for health-care professionals opposed to MAID.

canada.title: N.B. has to 'get aggressive,' Holt says as she releases new export strategy
canada.summary: The Holt government announced a plan Monday that aims to boost New Brunswick export markets and increase international export revenue by nearly 16 per cent over the next four years, and by 60 per cent interprovincially.

canada.title: Wekweètì, N.W.T., told to boil drinking water after water pump's 'critical mechanical failure'
canada.summary: The N.W.T.'s chief environmental health officer has issued a boil-water advisory for Wekweètì after a pump that supplies the water treatment plant failed.

canada.title: Nahanni Butte criticizes order for environmental assessment before cleanup of abandoned Cantung mine can begin
canada.summary: The Nahɂą Dehé Dene Band in Nahanni Butte, N.W.T., says it's disappointed with the Mackenzie Valley Land and Water Board's decision to send a cleanup plan for the Cantung tungsten mine for an environmental assessment.

canada.title: Chiefs question motive behind Indian Act talks after meeting with Carney, premiers
canada.summary: First Nations chiefs say their meeting with the prime minister and premiers was overshadowed by talk of abolishing the Indian Act.

canada.title: B.C. Conservatives gain 1 more seat, kicking out incumbent NDP MLA after final count
canada.summary: Conservative candidate David Xie has snatched the Burnaby South-Metrotown riding from NDP incumbent Paul Choi, winning by 64 votes, following the final vote count.

canada.title: Calgary living wage up slightly from last year: report
canada.summary: The Alberta Living Wage Network says Calgary's living wage — or the amount a full-time worker needs to meet their basic needs, manage unexpected expenses and participate meaningfully in their community — is now $26.90, up from $26.50 last year.
